evidence.title: PoseMy.Art | Free tool to create reference poses with 3D models.

name: PoseMy.Art
summary: Free browser tool for posing 3D models: 5500+ scenes, 6300+ poses and 2400+ mocap animations as figure-drawing reference.
description: A 3D model poser for artists: load a premade scene or pose a figure with inverse or forward kinematics, adjust camera FOV and lighting, swap characters and export the result as Open Pose, depth, canny or normals images. It runs in the browser on desktop and mobile, with a paid library of poses, scenes, animations, props, hands and anime, animal and realistic models.
contains: 6300+ premade poses and a pre-posed hand library
2400+ motion-capture animations, pausable on any frame
models: realistic, animal and anime figures, props, custom .obj import
camera FOV, directional light and image-plane controls
exports: Open Pose, depth, canny and normals images, scenes as .obj
free forever plan; Pro $15/month, $150/year or $99.99 lifetime; education from $3 per student per year
